item: Jar labels, white durable die-cut, printed on the LX500c with the 4 mm family stripe (blue/orange) along the top
pack: 1 roll, 750 labels, 3 in x 2 in (76 x 51 mm), Extreme Matte BOPP, 2 in core
notes: Nearest durable stock size: Primera makes no 2.75 x 1.25 in, and no gloss BOPP or polyester under 3 x 2 in, on the LX500's 2 in core. Its 17 2 in core labels include only three durable white ones: this, 075894 (4x3 matte BOPP, 500 per roll, $80) and 075843 (4x3 Extreme Gloss Polyester, 600 per roll, $92), all in stock. 073505 (3x1 in, 1,400 per roll, $31) is closer in size but paper. So the jar label grows from 70x32 to 76x51 mm: check it fits the smallest jar. The AP380 takes 2-3 in cores (manual spec via search snippet), so these rolls fit it. It wraps the 2 in along-web side around the jar and runs the 3 in side up the jar, so lay out the stripe for that or apply by hand. Check before buying: a Trustpilot review on Primera's listing says this BOPP 'doesn't feed well' in an LX500 (search snippet). The ink is dye-based, so wipe a test print with the lab's cleaning solvent (IPA) before trusting it near powders. An exact 2.75x1.25 in gloss-poly roll exists (Pacific Barcode M004-63-2813-1965, $143.02 per roll at qty 1), but on a 3 in core and 6 in OD, which the LX500 can't take. LabelValue (Cloudflare) refused, so no other-maker 2 in core alternative was priced.

item: NEC 210.5(C)(1) conductor-identification label posted at each panelboard (US 208Y/120 V and IEC 400/230 V), custom in colour
pack: uses 4 labels from the jar-label roll (3 x 2 in matte BOPP)
qty_basis: 4 panels x 1 label, from the 2 jar-label rolls above, so no extra pack
notes: Custom is the pick. The label shows each system's conductors as printed colour swatches with words: 208Y/120 L1 black, L2 red, L3 blue, N white, PE green; 400/230 L1 brown, L2 black, L3 grey, N blue, PE green-yellow. A pre-printed one won't do: the 'wire color code' labels on the market cover the US pair 208Y/120 + 480Y/277 (search snippets; none fetched), not IEC 400/230. NEC 110.21(B) wants field labels permanent and not handwritten, which rules out write-on blanks. If 3 x 2 in is too small, 075843 (4 x 3 in Extreme Gloss Polyester, $92 per 600) is the larger durable stock.

notes: Not priced: no custom-sign page was fetched in the time box. The LX500c prints at most about 4 in wide, so 'in-house' here means a poster print from a large-format printer (e.g. BYU's print services), laminated, on foam board or behind acrylic.
